correctness.rationale: PASS: The permitted weights are distinct products of exactly seven distinct rational primes. Independent enumeration of squarefree integers with omega(n)=7 recovered the first weight 510510 and c_3100=19111638, c_3101=19114095; an independently written exact 40,000,001-bit 0/1 subset-sum dynamic program with exactly those first 3100 weights proved 19027139 unreachable while every integer from 19027140 through 40000000 reachable. Unused weights exceed the alleged gap, so non-representability persists. For each c_j, replace its largest prime by the next prime q<2p by Bertrand: a valid 7-prime product is strictly between c_j and 2c_j, forcing c_(j+1)<2c_j. The starting interval width 20972861 exceeds c_3101, and two translated intervals concatenate inductively with growing width >= c_(j+2). This proves the infinite tail; the finite DP is exact, not sampling. The separate checked source C++ and alternative Python implementations show independent algorithm designs; own independent third implementation corroborated the exact finite certificate.
